_why: What a placement tag means to a campaign row: which instruction set its boxes execute, which GPU runtime a container there attaches with, and which host interpreters have actually been observed running work on it. A dispatcher row names a tag and an absolute interpreter path, and until this file existed nothing connected the two -- a spec could send a row to a box whose filesystem has no such interpreter, and the row failed at exec with the fleet's admission already spent. Every interpreter entry names the PrismaBuild action key that ran it there, so an entry is a receipt rather than a claim (CLAUDE.md principle 14). An entry is added by running something on the box and citing the key, never by asserting that a path exists.
_isa_why: The ISA is a placement fact with a measured consequence: a Tessera Hessian-aware wire encoded on gfx1201 is NOT bit-comparable with one encoded on sm121. First divergence is torch.linalg.cholesky (cuSOLVER vs rocSOLVER, one fp32 epsilon); 53.78% of differing rendered elements are explained by ldl and a further 15.28% by the encoder's own consumption of it, and 54.0% of rendered elements differ overall with max |delta| 9.48e-3 -- a different quantization, not a rounding wobble (RobTand/tessera#472, docs/measurements/tessera-gfx1201-hessian-divergence-2026-09-13.md on Tessera master). Weights-only encodes ARE byte-identical across the two: the wire the reference Viterbi produced there matched GB10's on both of its paths, digest for digest. So a row class whose bytes must equal a GB10 campaign's may only carry tags of one ISA, and cross-ISA capacity is reachable only for weights-only work.
_gpu_runtime_why: How a container on this tag reaches its GPU. `nvidia` is `--gpus all`, which is what the NVIDIA container runtime consumes. `rocm-wsl` is `--device /dev/dxg` plus a read-only `/usr/lib/wsl/lib` mount: WSL2 has no amdgpu driver and no NVIDIA runtime, so `--gpus all` attaches nothing there and `/dev/dxg` does not exist on a GB10. The value is per tag because it is a property of the box, not of the image.
_retired_interpreters_why: Only interpreters are current placement attestations. Optional retired_interpreters mappings retain historical action keys and observations, never active qualification. A path cannot be active and retired on the same tag. Missing or retired host attestation stamps [DEV-MODE] and continues with the spec by default through the existing seal_check; only PRISMAQUANT_DEV_MODE exactly 0 refuses. This does not establish runtime SDK or API compatibility.
